title: Ameresco Completes $5.9M Advanced Metering Infrastructure Project for the City of Mustang, Oklahoma
summary: Ameresco completed an AMI project in Mustang, Oklahoma, modernizing water metering ahead of schedule to strengthen operations and support long-term growth.
body_markdown:
## *Advanced metering infrastructure project designed to strengthen day-to-day water utility operations and support sustained growth for the City of Mustang and its residents*


**FRAMINGHAM, MA, and MUSTANG, OK, October 26, 2026** –[Ameresco, Inc.](https://www.ameresco.com/) , (NYSE: AMRC), a leading energy infrastructure company delivering integrated solutions to create reliable power and modernize infrastructure, today announced the completion of an Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) water meter project for the City of Mustang, Oklahoma. The $5.9M project replaced more than 8,000 water meters, modernizing the City’s metering system and supporting the long-term success of its water utility operations.


Ameresco worked closely with City staff from initial planning through final installation, beginning with an Investment Grade Audit that evaluated the existing metering system and assessed technology and implementation options. The evaluation gave the City a comprehensive view of project viability, costs, and long-term considerations, which supported informed decision-making aligned with the needs of the community.


Ameresco then managed installation and stakeholder coordination, completing construction in five months—half the original 10-month schedule. The City transitioned to its new AMI system with minimal disruption to residents and water utility operations.


“One of the things we appreciated most about working with Ameresco was that their involvement went beyond simply providing equipment or managing an installation,” said David Russell, Director of Public Works for the City of Mustang. “They served as a partner throughout the process, from evaluating our existing system and helping us determine whether the investment made sense, to selecting the appropriate approach, managing implementation, and helping City staff transition to the new system.”


Through a collaborative, data-driven approach, the project delivered key benefits for the City and its residents, including:


- Automated, remote meter reading across the City’s water system
- Detailed, timely usage data that helps City staff identify unusual consumption and investigate potential leaks
- Streamlined billing, account research, and customer service processes
- Continued customer service and billing coordination throughout the citywide meter replacement
- A customer portal that gives residents direct access to their water consumption information


“The City of Mustang’s collaboration with Ameresco is a direct reflection of how thoughtful planning and modern infrastructure create lasting value for a community,” said Louis Maltezos, Co-President of Ameresco. “Together, the City and Ameresco have strengthened the reliability of Mustang’s water system and established the operational insight required to meet the demands of growth with confidence.”


To learn more about Ameresco’s AMI and Automatic Meter Reading (AMR) solutions, visit[https://www.ameresco.com/advanced-metering-infrastucture/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ameresco.com%2Fadvanced-metering-infrastucture%2F&esheet=54558327&newsitemid=20260623422079&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ameresco.com%2Fadvanced-metering-infrastucture%2F&index=2&md5=98cc87a1ca0c6e9aab731b9bdb20d34e) .


**About Ameresco, Inc.**


Ameresco, Inc. (NYSE: AMRC) is a leading energy infrastructure company delivering integrated solutions to create reliable power and modernize infrastructure. The company’s *Power Infrastructure* business integrates energy resources across behind-the-meter and utility-scale systems. Its *Buildings & Public Infrastructure* business modernizes the built environment with smart, connected solutions that optimize performance and enhance resilience. Ameresco is a trusted full lifecycle partner, delivering over $15 billion in solutions and contracting over 5 GW of energy resources since its founding in 2000. Headquartered in Massachusetts, Ameresco serves public and private sector customers across North America and Europe. Learn more at[www.ameresco.com](https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.ameresco.com%2F&data=05%7C02%7Cmcahalan%40greenoughagency.com%7Cc787ad429c374400036b08dee83023ff%7C7ab732eaa60c4cbd9bcac284822be26c%7C0%7C0%7C639203490620777689%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=MxrH4NcVIQN2mSJL19BTxI7lI%2FSgn24Ft%2FUHdMD3%2Fjo%3D&reserved=0) .

What Advanced Metering Infrastructure project did Ameresco complete for the City of Mustang, Oklahoma?


Ameresco completed a $5.9 million Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) water meter project for the City of Mustang, Oklahoma, replacing more than 8,000 water meters and modernizing the City’s metering system to support water utility operations and sustained community growth.


How will the City of Mustang, Oklahoma benefit from Ameresco’s Advanced Metering Infrastructure project?


The City of Mustang will benefit from automated remote meter reading, detailed and timely water usage data, streamlined utility operations, and greater operational insight to support effective management of its water system as the community continues to grow.


How will residents of the City of Mustang benefit from the new Advanced Metering Infrastructure system installed by Ameresco?


The Ameresco Advanced Metering Infrastructure system gives City of Mustang residents access to a customer portal with water consumption information while supporting streamlined billing, account research, and customer service processes.


What Advanced Metering Infrastructure technology did Ameresco deploy for the City of Mustang, Oklahoma water system?


Ameresco deployed an Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) water metering system that enables automated remote meter reading, provides detailed water consumption data, and gives residents access to a customer portal for monitoring water usage information.


What is Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) for municipal water utilities?


Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) is a water metering technology that enables automated remote meter reading and provides detailed usage data that utilities can use to improve billing processes, customer service, account research, and day-to-day water utility operations.


How does the Ameresco Advanced Metering Infrastructure project help the City of Mustang identify potential water leaks and unusual water consumption?


The Ameresco AMI system provides detailed and timely water usage data that helps City of Mustang staff identify unusual consumption patterns and investigate potential leaks across the City’s water system more efficiently.


How does the Ameresco Advanced Metering Infrastructure project improve water utility operations in Mustang, Oklahoma?


The Ameresco Advanced Metering Infrastructure project improves water utility operations by automating meter reading, streamlining billing and account research processes, and providing operational insight that helps City staff manage water utility services more effectively.


Why is Advanced Metering Infrastructure important for growing communities like Mustang, Oklahoma?


The City of Mustang’s Advanced Metering Infrastructure system strengthens the reliability of the City’s water system and provides the operational insight needed to support community growth and future water utility service demands with confidence.
